# Theory: Diff Algorithms Decide What “Out of Sync” Means

Argo compares live Kubernetes objects to rendered Git. Ignore differences, jq paths, and server-side apply all change that predicate.

## Invariants

1. Webhook vs polling is how fast Git is noticed, not how sync works.
2. Health is controllers’ opinion (Deployment available), not Git.
3. External clusters need credentials in Argo’s DB/secret store.

```text
desired YAML  vs  live JSON   →  sync status
live conditions            →  health status
```

## What can break

- Ignoring `/spec/replicas` while HPA owns replicas (or vice versa).

## How to read this chapter

Registration, poll vs webhook, diffs, health.
